items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Clifford Smith played drums, and Lil Frank played the guitar, and Mitchell played the saxophone, he had a C melody. And Rudolph August played the alto and I played the trumpet. And that was my first band called the House Rockers.

ctx.x: Yeah. And we had instructions and we learned to therapy and reading and so forth. Because it was very, very good in, the music department in all public schools then was very, very good. I remember the band supervisor for Orleans Parish band directors was Rene Luop. Oh, that's right. Rene Luop. Yeah. It was a good thing. I, coincidence about Rene Luop, I also worked at a grocery store after school and I was Rene Luop's grocery boy. Uh-huh. I got to see him a lot more than I, a lot of the kids in the hoes, Orleans…
And, uh, very, very, very, from your name Luab? I mean these arrangements were playing cards?
